prompt:
A contact sheet of exactly eight square portrait photographs arranged in a precise grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, all eight cells exactly equal in size, touching edge to edge with no gutters, no borders, no captions. Each cell is a head-and-shoulders photo of a different anonymous runner seen from behind or in three-quarter back view (face not visible), centered in the cell: a woman with long straight hair and a white headband, a man with a buzz cut in a grey hoodie, a woman with short curly hair and a visor, a man with a navy cap worn backwards, a woman with two braids, a man with wavy hair and a black windbreaker, a woman with a low ponytail in an olive jacket, a man with a bald head and a coral shirt. Each against a softly blurred Seoul riverside, park or street background at night or morning. Consistent lighting and color across all eight cells.
Style: real-looking candid editorial photograph for a Korean running-crew app, natural light, shallow-to-medium depth of field, subtle film grain, true-to-life color (no heavy filters, no yellow color cast). Everyday anonymous runners in their 20s-30s of mixed pace and body types; faces turned away, in profile at a distance, or too small to identify. No logos on clothing, shoes or objects, no readable text, signage or numbers anywhere, no famous or recognizable landmark (buildings and bridges stay generic and hazy). No illustration, no 3D render, no watermark.
